description:
Find the cheapest petrol stations in Spain near a town, city or point, for one fuel.

    Returns the best stations by total cost (price plus the fuel used to get
    there), each with its price per litre, distance, whether it is open, and
    links to TankoUp and to directions.

fuel.description: Fuel type: diesel = Gasóleo A (regular diesel), diesel_premium = Gasóleo Premium, sp95 = Gasolina 95 E5 (regular unleaded petrol), sp95_e10 = Gasolina 95 E10, sp98 = Gasolina 98, lpg = GLP / autogas.
fuel.title: Fuel

open_now.description: Only stations open right now (unknown hours count as open).
open_now.title: Open Now
